fields.label: API Key
fields.description: Claude API key from console.anthropic.com. Stored encrypted; never sent to the browser.

fields.label: API Base URL
fields.description: Change only if you route requests through your own gateway or proxy.

fields.label: Model
fields.description: Model ID, for example claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5 or claude-fable-5-2. Use Test Connection to list the models your key can use.

fields.label: Reasoning Effort
fields.description: Leave blank to use the model default. Higher effort is slower and uses more tokens.

fields.label: Execution Mode
fields.description: Background Worker is recommended. Use Inline only on sites that run without background workers.

fields.label: Prompt Caching
fields.description: Reduces cost and latency on long conversations. Turn off if your gateway rejects the cache_control field.

fields.label: Model for Conversation Titles
fields.description: A small, fast model used only to name conversations. Leave blank to skip automatic titles.

fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Square image, shown in the launcher and chat header.

fields.label: Launcher Position
fields.description: Hidden removes the floating button; the assistant still opens with Ctrl+. and from its page.

fields.label: Tell Users Which AI Model Is Used
fields.description: When off, the assistant introduces itself only by the name above.

fields.label: Welcome Title
fields.default: How can I help you today?

fields.label: Welcome Message
fields.default: Ask about your data, request a report, or get help with anything.

fields.label: Suggested Prompts
fields.description: One per line. Shown as shortcuts on the welcome screen.
fields.default:
Show me sales by month for this year as a chart
Which customers have overdue invoices?
Build a report of stock below reorder level
Summarise the document I am looking at

fields.label: Company Instructions
fields.description: Standing instructions for every conversation: tone, terminology, fiscal year rules, what to avoid.

fields.label: Allow Read-only SQL
fields.description: Lets permitted users have the assistant run SELECT queries for analysis that needs joins. SQL does not apply row-level User Permissions, so limit it to trusted roles.

fields.label: Allow Saving Reports
fields.description: The assistant drafts and previews a report; it is saved only when the user clicks Save.

fields.label: Roles Allowed to Save Query Reports
fields.description: Query Reports contain SQL. Other users can still save Report Builder reports, which follow normal permissions.

fields.label: Add Saved Reports to a Workspace
Allow Creating and Updating Documents
fields.description: Every change is shown to the user first and runs with their own permissions only after they confirm.

fields.label: Allow Web Search
fields.description: Lets the assistant look up current information online. Billed by your AI provider per search.

fields.label: Daily Messages per User
fields.description: 0 means unlimited.

fields.label: Conversation Turns Kept in Context
fields.description: Older turns are summarised to keep cost down.

fields.label: Delete Conversations After (days)
fields.description: 0 keeps them forever.

fields.label: Keep an Audit Log of Data Access
